primary_edition_scope: 周相《大明大統曆法》明隆慶三年（1569）刊本
normalization_note: Decimal strings normalize source base-100 place values. 損益捷法 is represented in source seconds to four following place digits; this is not modern SI time.

shortcut_formula.historical_text: 置損益分以日率八百二十分而一，滿日率為秒，不滿為微纖，即為損益捷法。
shortcut_formula.normalized: truncate_4dp((損益分 × 100 seconds per source fen) / 820)

source_vs_reconstruction_policy: Formula values remain PENDING until directly read from the primary page. Only DIRECT_PRIMARY_MATCH counts as glyph-collated.
